verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say it lets users set up and manage grants and vesting in its stock option plan tooling. That is a first-party vesting capability, but only a single thin mention, so the depth of custom schedules is unproven. Missing for 10: documented custom cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), automatic vested vs unvested tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: Set up and manage stock option plans, grants, vesting, and exercises globally.
Design, manage, and communicate employee stock plans with clarity and confidence.
